name: leiden_msm_agreement
caption: Adjusted Rand index between Leiden communities (time-blind mutual-kNN on PCA of raw embeddings) and MSM macrostate assignments, with a 95% CI from resampling trajectories. High agreement can mean both methods found the same states or that both collapsed to one region — read next to n_macro.
alt_text: Adjusted Rand index between Leiden communities (time-blind mutual-kNN on PCA of raw embeddings) and MSM macrostate assignments, with a 95% CI from resampling trajectories. High agreement can mean both methods found the same states or that both collapsed to one region — read next to n_macro.
limitations: The CI resamples trajectories on frozen labels; it is not a refit CI. Leiden is not run in VAMP coordinates. UMAP is not used for any number. Cross-space ARI is 0 on qwen-raw because one space chose n_macro=1; that is arithmetic, not disagreement between two rich partitions.
